referenceBasis: All 579 frozen S3 target regions, partitioned by Spec section 2; none are removed from the inventory.
method: Source record, visible-range and current-variable alignment; an identified unique original RSC output is accepted without semantic-equivalence review. The implementing model checked provenance; no independent personnel or unseen set is claimed.
allowedChinese: Unchanged contiguous ranges of pinned original RSC records and their existing placeholders. Verified original native print callers may combine their original literals, complete original location terms and current observed numbers; numeric-only native fields add no Chinese wording. No authored or rewritten Chinese templates, corrected wording or inferred hidden values.
otherControls: Palette, waits, audio, coordinates and printing controls do not become displayed text. Elide only under reviewed source/printing correspondence; unknown controls or source roles remain explicit blockers, not evidence that RSC lacks a translation.
variables: 43 original RSC template families are approved by source qid, layout, reviewed source windows, slot role and source call-site role. Names/actor labels and numbers are rebound from the current input on every call. Moves, abilities, classes, stats, contest ranks and organizations use complete unchanged original terms. Normal experience distinguishes the Japanese two-buffer form from the English/RSC three-slot form. Never fill unseen rank, actor or amount using another frame. Explicitly reviewed same-event wording variants may select one unchanged original while retaining both witnesses; unresolved multiple applicable Chinese outputs remain ambiguous. No new Chinese template is authored.

gate.inventoryIntegrity: 579 unique target regions and all 1133 source-matcher units, with complete non-whitespace raw-character span accounting; 11 excluded regions and 5 scope-negative images stay separately registered.
gate.referenceIntegrity: Every unit has an explicit reviewed disposition and reason; every Chinese quote has a pinned file, record/line, applicable game, source hash and exact original character range.
gate.approvedOutput: Every approved fixture must reproduce frozen original wording or its verified original print format, with current values preserved. Both versions are checked separately; same-event original-wording selection is explicitly recorded. No unapproved Chinese is accepted.
gate.fallback: Unknown sources, multiple applicable original Chinese outputs, incomplete actors, unseen required variables and malformed values retain the observed unit. A unique original RSC output is never rejected for its wording, entity, factual or localization differences from Japanese. Original Chinese is not corrected. Prior-frame variables and later independent units cannot supply output.
gate.fullFirstEdition: Requires no unresolved in-scope units AND evidence for all required pages/states and both versions. Baseline integrity or legitimate Japanese fallback does not satisfy this coverage gate.

scopeExclusions.blender_message: Special berry-blender result/interaction layout; ordinary field_dialog text in the same venue remains in scope.
scopeExclusions.summary_battle_moves: Independent move summary page, beyond the required numeric/personality pages; battle_moves remains in scope.
scopeExclusions.summary_move_description: Independent move summary description; required battle interface remains in scope.

requiredPageEvidenceGaps: Both versions: screenshots have no confirmed per-image Ruby/Sapphire attribution or complete version-difference coverage.
PC: box grid, deposit/withdraw operations and their complete substate coverage require additional correspondence evidence.
Shop: selling, quantity selection and purchase/sale confirmation windows are not fully represented in the fixed set.
Battle: arbitrary names, dynamic buffers, all messages, multi-battle states and original RSC printing bindings are not fully approved.

Summary numeric/personality pages: native Trainer Memo title still lacks an approved original RSC correspondence; fixed observed met-location/level and ribbon print recipes are verified, but arbitrary locations and complete substate coverage remain open.
Standard dialogue outside these observed windows, including TV/Easy Chat/Tower composition and other version-specific sources, is not exhausted by this fixed baseline.
semanticUnits: Review source records, observed identifying windows and original RSC semantic spans separately. A reviewed identifying anchor may publish the complete same semantic unit, including across scrolling/clear controls, once all required current variables are visible. It must not publish a later independent unit. Japanese and Chinese line/page counts need not agree; never divide Chinese by source line number, length or punctuation alone.
nativeFields: Four verified original print sequences cover met location, met level marker/value/comma, ribbon trailing-zero overwrite and numeric-only remaining experience. Original labels/terms are cited exactly. Base punctuation and numeric-only formats are pinned to the original caller/literal, without inventing Chinese connectors. EXP is an invariant raw label, counted separately from unresolved retentions.
